main_text.p: aggeraverant, tandem in plani-tiem diffundit irriguum de majori Dyòta profluvium. Quin falsos amicos eâdem operâ detegimus: Nam reperto alicubi per larvam spiraculo, exhalat sæpenumerò cum fumis Lyæi, indoles quædam humilis & prava, inimica candori, probum illud ac industrium indignè exagitans; vafro tamen, quamdiu excubabat, ingenio dissimulata: Et qui terga latenter infestaverat Sufurro, formam immutante Libero, faciem non reveretur Contumeliosus: Ridemus dum se prodit: & miseret nos, tantum antehac calamistris & fuco deformem impendisse Momum.
Contrà tamen facit, quòd propinatio ista frequentior, amicos dolio tuo pariat, non tibi: Donec huic vena fluet, adhærebunt lateri Achates isti: Nutus observant obvii,

page.notes: The right margin carries faint, partly cut-off marginal notes that cannot be read reliably and are not transcribed. The first line is a running head with the page number 256. The text ends with the catchword "obvii," at the lower right. Words with doubtful letters: "Ridemus" and "Libero" are read as printed. The word "industrium" uses a long-s form and is copied as printed.
